subject: Issue with the pending department request
text:
Dear Professor,

I am writing to note a small issue with the unfinished task currently assigned to our team. The requested update was started, but a missing attachment prevented us from marking it complete before the end of the business day.

The remaining work appears limited to confirming the details and closing the item in the tracker. No other records seem to be affected. If it would help, I can add a brief note to the ticket so the status is clearer when you review it this week.

I apologize for the incomplete progress and would be grateful for guidance on whether you prefer us to wait or proceed with the next step now.

Please let me know if you would like the ticket to remain open until I can contact the responsible unit for the missing file. I will keep the description factual and avoid any unnecessary changes to the original request.

Sincerely,
Support Desk
